byokModel.title: You have your own API key — but chats still use Atlarix Core
byokModel.body: Pick one of your provider's models here to run on your key instead. The button opens the full list.

byokDefault.detail: Your key is saved, but new chats still use Atlarix Core until you change the model.
byokDefault.willUse: New chats would use {{model}}. Change it any time from the model picker.

workspace.bodyFirst: Atlarix is workspace-first — chat, sessions, tools and memory all belong to one project folder. Open a folder you already have, or an empty one — then ask the agent to clone into it, from any git host, using your own git credentials.
workspace.bodyExisting: You are set up already — chat, sessions, tools and memory belong to the folder you are in. Add another folder whenever you want one, or finish and get back to work.
